newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to name U.S. partner for Latam.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to name U.S. partner for Latam.

text.p: Spanish telecoms operator Telefonica said it would reveal the name of its U.S. partner for developing a pan-American network shortly.

"In the next few weeks we will announce who the North American partner we have chosen is," Telefonica de Espana chairman Juan Villalonga told a parliament committee late on Thursday. "That will be the vehicle that allows us to offer global telecoms services to our main clients in Latin America."
Villalonga said the partnership would also help the Spanish operator enter the Hispanic market in the United States.
